SELECT id AS sourceId,serial_number AS name FROM product_bom_info WHERE state=#{state} AND is_deleted = FALSE
AND serial_number LIKE concat('%',#{searchKeyword},'%')

select pbi.id as bomId, pd.images_url as imagesUrl, pd.name as skuName, pd.id as skuId, pd.sku_no as skuNo, pi.id as productId, pi.spu_no as spuNo, pd.status, pi.category, pi.brand_name as brandName, pbi.bom_version as bomVersion from product_bom_info pbi inner join product_bom_sku pbs on pbi.id = pbs.bom_id and pbs.is_deleted = false left join product_detail pd on pbs.sku_no = pd.sku_no and pd.is_deleted = false left join product_info pi on pd.product_id = pi.id and pi.is_deleted = false
pbi.is_deleted = false and pbi.state = 4
